text:
maria: Evening handoff — ongoing incident summary below, please read fully. Shadow-router in eu-west began returning 502s ~20:40 UTC, we've seen elevated P95 and a customer-facing 5xx rate of ~4.8% for requests routed via shadowing to private deployments. Pager triggered and SREs are active.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-89 created · Severity: P1 · Pager: oncall@redwood · Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-89

ajay: ack — I'm stepping in as secondary for this handoff window (next 4h).

kristen: mitigation status (short):
- disabled shadowing flag for eu-west: `feature-toggle:shadow_routing_eu=false` (propagated)
- scaled shadow-router deployment `shadow-router-eu` +2 pods (kubectl scale)
- rolled back most recent config change that touched route maps (deploy id: deploy-2026-0314-682)
- temporarily pinned routing to route-v2 for affected customers
Observed: error rate dropped from 4.8% -> 2.1% after disabling shadowing, latency P95 improved ~120ms.

li: customer impact note: support has an open thread with three EU customers on dedicated plans reporting 502s on list endpoints (/v1/generate). Business SLO flagged but not yet SLA breach. Added link to customer threads in INC-2026-89.

maria: current open actions (what I'd like incoming primary to own):
1) Keep shadowing disabled in eu-west while we confirm root cause.
2) Monitor error rate and latency for next 30m and report every 10m in this thread.
3) If error rate falls below 1% for 30m, consider re-enabling shadowing in a canary with 1% traffic.
4) If errors spike >6% or latency P95 > 1s, escalate to Seon and prepare failover to eu-central routing pool.

kristen: runbook pointers and quick commands we used: 
- Runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/shadow-router-failure (section: emergency disable shadowing)
- To check pods: 
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=shadow-router -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/shadow-router-eu -c router --tail=200
```
- To disable feature toggle (launchdarkly): 
```
ldctl update toggle shadow_routing_eu --env=production --value=false
```
- To scale: 
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment shadow-router-eu --replicas=6
```

ajay: additional observations: we saw a small spike of 429s right before 502 flood — likely overloaded connection pool to private-backend. We're coordinating with eng-runtime to check connection pool metrics and file descriptors on the shadow-router nodes.

maria: coverage notes: primary for next 4h: ajay, secondary: kristen, backup on-call for escalation: seon. After that, there's a coverage gap between 02:00-05:00 UTC where we don't have a dedicated APAC-aware oncall listed in schedule — @seon please confirm if you can cover or we need to call in the APAC oncall.

seon: I can extend cover until 03:30 UTC but then need to hand off. Recommend we loop in the APAC rotation and set a follow-up bridge if still open.

li: Support action: customer-facing status updated to "Degraded performance" and posted to status.redwood.com with a note that we're investigating routing.

maria: notes for oncoming shift — things to watch for:
- Error rate trend (INC dashboard) — if steady downwards and <1% for 30m, move to canary re-enable.
- Latency P95 for /v1/generate and /v1/embeds in eu-west.
- Shadow-router pod restarts or OOMs in node logs.
- Connection pool metrics: queued connections > 100 is concerning.

ajay: accepting handoff — I'll own monitoring cadence and next steps. If we need to do failover to eu-central routing pool, I'll coordinate with eng-runtime and post the plan here before action.

maria: thanks — leaving notes in the incident ticket. If anything changes ping @ajay directly or escalate to @seon. :thumbsup:

kristen: small gotcha recorded — a config residue in route-map `shadow-to-private` caused incorrect header rewriting; that was rolled back but worth a postmortem.

ajay: action items I picked up:
- Watch error/latency => post status every 10m.
- Confirm connection pool health on shadow-router nodes.
- Coordinate with eng-runtime on failover plan if needed.
- Notify product lead if we escalate to eu-central failover.

maria: handing off now. Good luck and ping me if you need help.

ajay: got it, taking over.
